conditions.deletion: Remove sentences that repeat information already stated or contribute nothing needed for the request. Preserve meaning, keywords, evidence, and qualifications. If preservation is uncertain, retain the original.

harness: Fresh session subagents; inherited model, exact identifier not recorded. One session per condition/repetition; six cases share a session.
decision_rule: Consider adding the explicit deletion rule only if it reduces remaining unnecessary repetition relative to the current skill without introducing fidelity failures. Lower word count alone is insufficient. Otherwise retain the current skill; a small pilot cannot establish broad reliability.

redundant: Repeated statements of targeted success or unrun full suite

required: Retry policy is maintained in the configuration reference
One maintained source may reduce document drift; benefit remains qualified
redundant: Repeated explanation of one maintained policy or possible drift reduction

required: Approval is required before ordinary deployment
Emergency exception requires on-call lead authorization AND an audit-log record
Emergency changes require approval within 24 hours
Six of ten pilot volunteers reported usefulness
Reports do not establish error reduction
Reference-style citation and correct URL preserved
Each checklist independently includes backup before maintenance
Each independently includes enable maintenance, respective worker restart, disable maintenance in order
standalone.note: Repetition between standalone checklists is necessary; do not penalize it.

review: Two fresh session subagents reviewed shuffled outputs with condition and repetition labels removed. Each saw requests, drafts, and the prewritten rubric. Both are LLM reviewers, not human annotators. The root agent inspected the first repetition of all three conditions and the reported equivalence case.
